title: One finite-projective model for individually constant derived reductions
statement: Let $W$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose final-object evaluation takes epimorphisms of set-valued sheaves on its small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] to surjections. Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $J$ an ideal, and $H\in D(\underline A)$ a locally derived $J$-complete complex [def-weil-pbc-locally-derived-ringed-ideal-complete]. Assume each canonical reduction $H_n=H\otimes_A^L\underline{A/J^{n+1}}$ is individually isomorphic to the constant realization of some $E_n\in D(A/J^{n+1})$, with $E_0$ perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. No compatibility of these markings is required. Put $B=\widehat A$ and $I=JB$. There is one bounded complex $P$ of finite projective $B$-modules such that, for every integer $q$, the actual cohomology-and-final-sections tower of $H_n$ has a finite-triple comparison [lem-sfb-finite-triple-range-ml-transfer] with $\underline{H^q(P/I^{n+1}P)}(W)$. Here sections of constant modules and canonical quotient cohomology are the actual constructions in [lem-sfb-adic-short-complex-cohomology-ml]. This conclusion asserts a geometric model and the two finite-triple comparison equations; it asserts no stabilization.

proof.text: The proved auxiliary constantReductionsRealization_iso in this module identifies the actual representative construction with the existing exact derived constant functor [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor]. The comparison identifies the coefficient ring isomorphisms on constant sections, applies the existing module-sheafification transport, and then the derived-functor representative comparison. If W is empty, every displayed section module is zero and take P=0. Otherwise use [lem-sfb-constant-realization-reflects-isomorphism-general] on the coefficient-sized site; transport between the RingCat and CommRingCat coefficient presentations by the same exact coefficient isomorphism. Use [lem-sfb-constant-realization-derived-scalar-extension] and [lem-sfb-successive-derived-quotient-normalization] to identify all successive reductions together with their units.

Reduce each E_n to A/J. Its constant realization is identified with that of the perfect residue E_0. Apply the perfectness-reflection corollary of [lem-sfb-constant-realization-reflects-isomorphism-general] to the inverse identification, whose source is perfect. The ideal J/J^(n+1) in A/J^(n+1) is nilpotent. Apply [lem-sfb-perfect-nilpotent-reduction] to conclude that E_n is perfect; this lemma retains both bounds and finite generation of the lifted terms.

Apply the same local algebraicity to each consecutive transition between the marked sheaf reductions. Choose its algebraic lift on one nonempty covering member. The transpose after algebraic derived reduction is an isomorphism, because constant realization takes it to the normalized successive-quotient isomorphism and reflects isomorphisms there. Choose one such map at every index; composites define a normalized algebraic tower.

The proved auxiliary constantReductionsCompletionKer computes the kernel of each completion evaluation as I^(n+1). The actual quotient equivalence constantReductionsCompletionIso identifies B/I^(n+1) with A/J^(n+1), and constantReductionsCompletionIso_mk identifies its value on each representative with evaluation. Thus these comparisons commute with the projections; the complete-ring setup is [lem-weil-pbc-adic-completion-mod-ideal]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-rlim-perfect-complete] to the algebraic tower to obtain a perfect $B$-complex with those reductions. Its bounded finite-projective representative $P$ computes derived reductions termwise by [lem-pc-kflat-closure] and [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. The canonical equivalence between the small Grothendieck derived localization and the standard localization carries these representatives to the standard categories by [lem-sfb-perfect-change-derived-localization]. The quotient functors and their units are transported by their universal adjunction comparison, retaining the normalization on cochain representatives.

For $t\geq m\geq n$, choose one level-$t$ constant marking of $P$ and reduce it to $m$ and $n$. The normalized scalar-extension comparisons send $(x\otimes a)\otimes b$ to $x\otimes ab$, so both quotient arrows coincide with the strict quotient-tower arrows. This also covers identity arrows. Exact constant realization commutes with cohomology; evaluation of the underlying constant module gives the comparison bijections and both equations. No globally compatible infinite family of markings is chosen.

theorem constant_reductions_finite_projective_model
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine W]
    (_hW : ∀ (F G : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) (Type (u + 1))) (f : F ⟶ G),
      Epi f → Function.Surjective (f.hom.app (op (⊤_ W.ProEt))))
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (H : ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A))
    (_hcomplete : ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
      (ConstantCompletion.quotient (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A J 0) H)
    (_hconstant : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ E :
        @DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} (A ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))) _ _
          (HasDerivedCategory.standard _),
      (n = 0 → @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex _ _
        (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) E) ∧
      Nonempty
        ((ConstantCompletion.extend
            (ConstantCompletion.quotient (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A J n)).obj H ≅
          constantReductionsRealization (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W)
            (A ⧸ J ^ (n + 1)) E)) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} (AdicCompletion J A)) ℤ)
      (a b : ℤ), P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective (AdicCompletion J A) (P.X i) ∧
        Module.Finite (AdicCompletion J A) (P.X i)) ∧
      ∀ q : ℤ, CategoryTheory.Functor.FiniteTripleRangeComparison
        ((constantReductionsTowerCohomology
            (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A) q).obj
            ((ConstantCompletion.quotientPresentation
              (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A J false).tower.obj H) ⋙
          SheafOfModules.evaluation.{max v (u + 1)}
            (siteModuleRings
              (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W) A))
            (op (AsSmall.up.obj (⊤_ W.ProEt))) ⋙
          CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat _))
        (AdicCohomology.tower (J.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion J A))) (P.sc q) ⋙
          AdicCohomology.sections.{max v (u + 1)} (R := AdicCompletion J A)
            (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} W)
            (AsSmall.up.obj (⊤_ W.ProEt)) ⋙ CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat _))
